dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: This is the last Survey Anchor. Let's return to the Institute.

dialogues.speaker: Chronie
dialogues.text: I'm curious. Did any of the adventurers who responded to the recruitment come and get this kind of Survey Anchor?

dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: Of course, and there were quite a few. This Survey Anchor retrieval test is part of the qualification review.

dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: After the initial phase of the qualification review, they will try to make contact with the Survey Anchors under the supervision of Institute researchers.

dialogues.speaker: Nacker
dialogues.text: They consumed a lot of our antiemetics.
